parent_objective: design bounded effective-config schema repair after M2388 failed closed on missing env_config
blocked_by: M2388 candidate configs pass static checks but lack reset-ready env_config
effective config materialization remains blocked until base env config lineage and merge semantics are designed
supersedes: direct reset rerun from overlay-only candidate configs
direct repair execution, training, or ranking before effective config schema repair

public_gates: M2390 must design effective-config schema repair without materializing or resetting configs
M2390 must identify legitimate base env config lineage or fail closed
M2390 must preserve active config overwrite, actor-input, oracle-feature, profile-specific tuning, ranking, and claim guardrails
M2390 must choose a bounded materialization route, pivot, synthesis, or stop route
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not materialize effective configs in M2390
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs bounded schema repair so generated candidate overlays can become reset-ready effective configs
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: schema repair design only; no materialization, reset, rollout, repair execution, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if no legitimate base env config lineage can be identified
stop if design would overwrite active config
stop if design would run reset or materialize effective configs in M2390
stop if design routes directly to rollout training ranking or paper conclusions
fallback_plan: route to bounded effective-config materialization if base lineage and merge semantics are clear
pivot to complexity-pruning synthesis if schema repair adds only local artifact work
stop for user review if no bounded executable validation path is supported
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2389 audits schema incompleteness and admits bounded schema repair design

admission_evidence: M2389 classifies M2388 failure as effective_config_materialization_failure
blocked_shortcuts: no effective config materialization in M2390
allowed_updates: M2390 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: base env config lineage is identified or branch stops
candidate overlay merge semantics are specified
run-dir-only effective config output schema is specified
a bounded materialization route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2390 designs config schema repair and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2390; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2388 fail-closed reset-readiness result and M2389 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Schema repair remains task-quality infrastructure and cannot be interpreted as driver capability or self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: can unblock executable reset validation by adding effective config schema if bounded
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare current-sim validation readiness but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2390 cannot identify base env config lineage
M2390 proposes another artifact-only repair without executable validation path
M2390 proposes active config overwrite, reset, training, ranking, or current-sim verdict
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded design can repair candidate config schema by defining base env config lineage and run-dir effective config materialization without active config overwrite, reset, rollout, repair execution, ranking, or training-success claims.
success_criteria: base env config lineage is identified or branch stops
effective config schema and merge semantics are specified
active config overwrite, reset, rollout, repair execution, ranking, and training remain blocked in M2390
a bounded materialization follow-up route is selected or the branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2390 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2390 materializes effective configs or overwrites active config
M2390 executes repair levers or trains
M2390 ranks support policies or controller families
M2390 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim verdict or level3 self-ID claims
M2390 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success

commands.name: design
commands.command: write bounded effective-config schema repair design

decision_rule: M2390 passes if it designs a bounded effective-config schema repair route or stops the branch without active config overwrite, reset/rollout, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims.
